structured.answer: I'd want option א, the coin towers: two piles with one big number under each (66,513 ₪ in the keren against 19,595 ₪ in the plain account), and one sentence saying each shekel becomes 3.70 against 1.09. That shows me plainly that the keren is worth it.

stuck.where: Table under option א, row 'מס במשיכה'
stuck.why: The −13,974 ₪ made me stop and doubt the keren until I understood it only applies before 6 years

stuck.where: Option ב, the floating steps chart
stuck.why: Blocks hang in the air with +527, +60,365 and −13,974 above them; I couldn't tell what adds to what
Too many colours and numbers, and the white line across them; I gave up on it
